Earlier unapproved interpretations were not counted as completed designs.

productStaticFindings.problem: Trailing currency could be borrowed by the next endpoint, splitting a monthly PLN range.
productStaticFindings.resolution: Bind a marker to its owned token and preserve the full range.

productStaticFindings.problem: Dash after a city/pay label could be rejected as a unary minus; a broad initial exception also accepted arbitrary negative prose.
productStaticFindings.resolution: Bounded known-city/pay-label punctuation with whitespace checks, without scope/period/currency inference.

productStaticFindings.problem: Slash handling rejected legacy prose and could rescue a denominator from malformed numeric expressions.
productStaticFindings.resolution: Explicit supported period annotations, legacy nonnumeric slash prose and whole progressing invalid numeric tails.

productStaticFindings.problem: Tight range connectors and signed right endpoints had incorrect ownership.
productStaticFindings.resolution: Distinguish complete range connectors from actual unary signs; reject the full malformed range.

productStaticFindings.problem: Numeric continuation after an annotation could rescue a smaller prefix; a later variant lost trailing currency and misleadingly preserved old saved salary.
productStaticFindings.resolution: Keep the complete invalid span and recover only its own terminal currency as evidence.

productStaticFindings.problem: CR-only numeric lists could be mistaken for unsupported wrapped ranges.
productStaticFindings.resolution: Preserve consistent LF, CRLF and CR boundaries.

productStaticFindings.problem: Repeated label lookbehind could perform quadratic work on dense input.
productStaticFindings.resolution: Only inspect the bounded 128-character label window when the required punctuation exists.

earlierImplementationGate.problem: After changing a query, an unqualified click could select the previous published result before the worker responded.
earlierImplementationGate.resolution: Fable scoped clicks to the requested literal title in both selected compensation specs; outputs, retries and timeouts unchanged. All3 approved candidate02 before execution.

Raw numeric grammar counts include non-pay text and must not be interpreted as confirmed salary or defect counts.

The recognizer joins supported numeric tokens, connectors and annotations. Word-form per-year connectors, intervening geographic prose and other unsupported text retain their existing interpretation; this change does not guarantee that every unsupported prose shape rejects every numeric value.
Known-city and pay-label punctuation is distinguished from a unary minus using bounded lookbehind. It does not infer geographic salary applicability, period or currency from a city.
Raw source values are not repaired based on plausibility. An explicit K suffix or implausibly low source amount retains its literal meaning if the grammar is otherwise valid.

Existing compensation-kind and period inference are unchanged. Separately observed signing-bonus-as-base and review-frequency-as-period examples remain candidates for a later independently designed stage.
The requested review settings are GPT-6 Astra/max and Claude Code Fable 5.1/max. Claude response metadata identifies the actual model, but does not expose the effective backend effort.
Unanimous review is a decision to advance on the recorded evidence. It is not a guarantee of a defect-free product or correctness outside the checked scope.
